newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Kolodko sees yr/yr CPI at 17.9 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Kolodko sees yr/yr CPI at 17.9 pct in Dec.

text.p: Poland's Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said he expected year-on-year inflation to fall to 17.9 percent in December 1996 from 19.5 percent in September, PAP news agency reported on Wednesday.
"In 1996 inflation...counted from December to December will be held at a level of 17.9 percent," PAP quoted Kolodko as telling the Senate's national economy committee.
The government's official consumer price growth target for 1996 was 17 percent, but market analysts have often said this goal was too ambitious.
According to the latest Reuter poll of Poland's largest banks conducted last month, year-on-year inflation is seen falling to 18.74 percent in December.
